title: Validate exact staged blobs and fail closed in pre-commit
problem: Verified at committed HEAD: `.githooks/pre-commit` enumerates staged paths but the checkers read working-tree files, skip missing paths, and ignore Git/checker return codes. Proposed impact: staged content can be bypassed or checker failures can appear successful.
acceptance: A staged failing blob is rejected even when the working-tree copy is valid; the inverse passes.
A staged file deleted from the working tree is still checked from the index.
Git failures, checker nonzero exits, stderr-only failures, and renamed Python files fail closed with diagnostics.
No-staged-Python behavior and existing checks tests remain green.

title: Fail closed when shared scan discovery cannot traverse an authored directory
problem: Verified at committed HEAD: `checks.config.scan_files()` calls `os.walk()` without an error callback. Proposed failure mode: traversal errors can silently omit authored directories, leaving filesize, complexity, and style with an incomplete manifest.
acceptance: A hermetic traversal-error fixture for an existing authored directory causes discovery and each applicable gate to fail with a directory-specific diagnostic.
`cli.py check` remains fail closed while reporting subsequent gate results.
Directory pruning, deterministic ordering, empty-root behavior, and existing scan tests remain unchanged.

title: Make the pre-push harness include a bounded H0 self-test
problem: Verified at committed HEAD: `.githooks/pre-push` invokes `cli.py harness`, while `cmd_harness()` delegates only to G1-G4; `Makefile:harness` additionally runs H0. `cmd_check_test()` also launches unittest discovery without a timeout. Proposed impact: pre-push can be falsely green or hang indefinitely.
acceptance: The pre-push harness runs all four gates plus H0, and any failure returns nonzero.
A hanging self-test and its child processes are terminated by a bounded deadline with an actionable diagnostic.
Normal self-tests complete successfully, leave no orphan processes, and existing CLI dispatch tests remain green.
